_comment: Creature Burn (2026-11-20, Stage 2 batch 2). The 0-power attack HOLD and the post-combat lethal FINISH in the
real game: the opponent is at 2; an un-sick Goblin Fireslinger and an un-sick Cinder Pyromancer are untapped
and we hold nothing. The Fireslinger attacks for 1 (a 1-power pinger attacks for exactly its ping); the 0/1
Pyromancer is HELD home (DecisionProvider::AttackWith -- attacking would deal 0 and forfeit the ping), so
right after combat damage its ping covers the last point (PingDorkFinish) -- a turn-3 win. Had it attacked,
nothing would be left to ping on turn 3 and the game would go to turn 4.
